title: Freshworks Swings to $18.3 Million Profit in Q3 as Revenue Rises 14% to $245.4 Million
excerpt: The Chennai-founded software firm posted its second straight GAAP-profitable quarter, record free cash flow of $73.9 million, and crossed $1 billion in annual recurring revenue ahead of schedule.
body:
• Freshworks reported Q3 2026 revenue of $245.4 million, up 14% year over year, and GAAP net income of $18.3 million against a $4.7 million loss a year earlier.
  • Adjusted free cash flow hit a record $73.9 million, up 29%; non-GAAP operating margin widened to 29.8% from 21.0%.
  • The Chennai-founded software firm crossed $1 billion in annual recurring revenue in October, ahead of its year-end estimate.
  • Guidance: Q4 2026 revenue of $253.5–254.5 million and full-year revenue of $965–966 million, both implying roughly 14–15% growth.

Freshworks has swung firmly into profit. The Nasdaq-listed software company reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $245.4 million, up 14% from $215.1 million a year earlier, and GAAP net income of $18.3 million, according to its earnings release — a second consecutive quarter of GAAP profitability. Revenue was in line with the $245.1 million consensus estimate tracked by StockStory.

The numbers

GAAP income from operations was $28.2 million, an 11.5% operating margin, against an operating loss of $7.5 million in Q3 2025. Non-GAAP income from operations rose to $73.2 million, a 29.8% margin, up from $45.2 million and 21.0% a year earlier. GAAP diluted EPS was $0.07, against a loss of $0.02 per share a year ago; non-GAAP EPS was $0.22, up from $0.16. Adjusted free cash flow reached a record $73.9 million, up 29% from $57.2 million, and the company held $697.3 million in cash, equivalents and marketable securities at September 30. All 2026 figures include the FireHydrant business.

"Our upmarket strategy delivered another strong quarter. We delivered a 30% non-GAAP operating margin and grew adjusted free cash flow by 29%."

— Dennis Woodside, CEO & President, Freshworks

Where the growth is coming from

The push into larger customers is showing in the metrics. Customers contributing more than $100,000 in annual recurring revenue rose 25% year over year to 1,821, and those above $50,000 rose 18% to 4,257. Net dollar retention was 104%. New customers in the quarter included Tata Technologies, Texas Christian University, Unilabs (UK) and Jose Cuervo, and the company was added to the S&P SmallCap 600 index. After the quarter closed, Freshworks crossed $1 billion in annual recurring revenue — a milestone it had previously expected to reach by year-end. "Customers want a unified platform and single data model for service operations, and they are increasingly choosing Freshworks," Woodside said.

What to watch next

For the fourth quarter, Freshworks guided to revenue of $253.5–254.5 million (about 14% growth) and non-GAAP operating income of $68–70 million. Full-year 2026 guidance is revenue of $965–966 million, roughly 15% growth. Those are the company's own estimates, subject to its forward-looking-statements caution. The company, founded in Chennai and now headquartered in San Mateo, remains one of the most closely watched Indian-origin software firms on US markets — and this quarter, growth and profit arrived together.
